mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_account, title, content, type, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{userAccount}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_account, title, content, type, is_read AS `read`, create_time FROM notification WHERE user_account = #{userAccount} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_account, title, content, type, is_read AS `read`, create_time FROM notification WHERE user_account = #{userAccount} AND is_read = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_account = #{userAccount} AND is_read = 0
